decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed erection of a first and second floor rear extension, and the conversion of existing residential flat above shop to provide two one-bedroom flats, because of its design, position and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 259 High Street and would accord with the Councils Residential Standards and Controls, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties. On balance, the development is in accordance with Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1, H.4.1, H.3.3 and IMP.2.2. It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the units are occupied.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northeast and southwest wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The flats hereby permitted shall not be occupied until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound between the floors and the internal walls of the flats and shop below has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 8 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of  08.00 to 18.00 on Mondays to Friday and 08.00 to 13.00 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of 1st floor rear extension to provide additional storage area to retail unit and erection of 2nd floor extension and conversion of existing maisonette to provide two x 1 bedroom flats.
